1. (Currently amended) A sensor system, comprising: a sensor device having an external surface on which is arranged at least one electrical test contact; and a cover device including at least partially an electrically insulating material, the cover device mechanically connected to the sensor device, __wherein the cover device is configured to electrically isolate the at least one electrical test contact from external electrical connections while maintaining mechanical accessibility to the sensor device__.

2. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the cover device has an internal surface configured to face the external surface including the at least one test contact, and at least one further metallization is arranged on the internal surface, __the at least one further metallization electrically isolated from the at least one electrical test contact and configured to prevent electrical communication between the at least one electrical test contact and external circuitry__.

3. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, further comprising: at least one electrical connecting contact arranged on the external surface including the at least one test contact, wherein the cover device is configured to enable electrical contact to be made to the at least one electrical connecting contact from outside the sensor system, __and wherein the at least one electrical connecting contact is electrically distinct from and isolated from the at least one electrical test contact__.

4. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 3, wherein the cover device includes at least one of at least one first opening and at least one via electrically connected to the at least one electrical connecting contact to enable electrical contact to be made from outside the sensor system, __wherein the at least one via and the at least one first opening do not provide electrical access to the at least one electrical test contact__.

5. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the sensor device includes a sensor substrate configured to form the external surface including the at least one test contact, the cover device includes a cover substrate having a first segment corresponding to the external surface, and the first segment of the cover device and the external surface including the at least one test contact are connected together at least partially, __wherein the cover substrate is formed from a material that provides electrical insulation between the at least one electrical test contact and any external conductive elements__.

6. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 5, wherein the cover device includes a second segment configured to bound the first segment and at least partially enclose the sensor device at right angles to the external surface, __wherein the second segment is integrally formed with the first segment as a single monolithic structure__.

7. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, further comprising: at least one of the sensor device and the cover device includes at least one of an energy storage unit and an energy converter unit, and the at least one of the energy storage unit and the energy converter unit is configured to be used to supply the sensor device with power, __wherein the energy storage unit or energy converter unit is positioned within the cover device and is electrically isolated from the at least one electrical test contact__.

8. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 7, wherein: the energy converter unit includes at least one of a photovoltaic cell and a thermoelectric generator, and the cover device includes at least one corresponding second opening, __wherein the second opening is positioned to expose the energy converter unit to external environmental conditions while maintaining electrical isolation of the at least one electrical test contact__.

9. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 8, further comprising at least one of a transparent protective layer and a thermally conductive material introduced at least partially in the second opening.

10. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the sensor device and the cover device includes an integrated circuit, __wherein the integrated circuit is electrically isolated from the at least one electrical test contact and is configured to control sensor operations independently of external electrical connections to the at least one electrical test contact__.

11. (Currently amended) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein: the sensor device includes at least one access aperture, and the cover device includes at least one third opening corresponding to the at least one access aperture, __wherein the at least one third opening does not provide electrical access to the at least one electrical test contact__.

12. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the cover device and the sensor device includes at least one fastening mechanism configured to enable the sensor system to be fitted to another object.

13. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 12, wherein the at least one fastening mechanism is formed as one of a suction pad, a pin, an adhesive surface, a hook-and-loop fastener, an electrostatic pad and a magnet.

14. (Currently amended) A cover device for a sensor system, comprising: __a cover substrate including at least partially an electrically insulating material; and at least one fastening mechanism configured to enable the cover device to be fitted to a sensor device having an external surface on which is arranged at least one electrical test contact, wherein the cover device is configured such that, when a mechanical connection is made between the cover device and the sensor device, the cover device covers the at least one electrical test contact of the sensor device to electrically isolate the at least one electrical test contact from external electrical connections__.

15. (Previously presented) The cover device according to claim 14, wherein the at least one fastening mechanism is formed as one of a suction pad, a pin, an adhesive surface, a hook-and-loop fastener, an electrostatic pad, and a magnet.

16. (Previously presented) The sensor system according to claim 10, wherein the integrated circuit is a wireless communications unit for data transmission.
